facts.fact: Boursenews reports 14 million payments via mobile wallet in 2024 through SWAM and more than 10 million active wallets in Morocco.
Boursenews says SWAM operates as the national switch ensuring interoperability between banks, payment institutions, merchants and cardholders, with 48 connected participants.

Boursenews describes SWAM as the national switch handling routing, clearing and settlement, carrying over 400 million ATM withdrawals, 210 million payments and 14 million mobile wallet payments in 2024.
